title: repo2ree behaviour journal record
description: One line of a behaviour journal. Generated from assurance/spec/vocabulary by `python -m scripts.contracts write behaviour-schema`; do not edit. Sequence, epochs, and the header are checked per journal by `python -m repo2ree_assurance_checker validate-journal`.

operations.initialize_ree: Start a new REE: its definition, its scripts, and the first commit of its history.
operations.acquire_source: Fetch the source from its origin, or take it from an archive, and freeze it.
operations.remove_source: Remove the frozen source, keeping the scripts and the definition.
operations.load_ree_bundle: Replace the REE with a bundle, sealed or draft, its receipts included.
operations.patch_ree_definition: Change the REE's declarations: its name, catalog entry, experiment environment and experiments, whose scripts come and go with them.
operations.write_script: Overwrite one of the REE's scripts: each always has one.
operations.suggest_scripts: Propose build experiment environment and activation scripts from the source and the machine.
operations.evaluate_reproducibility: Assess how fully the source pins its dependencies.
operations.observe_hardware: Record the hardware the machine offers.
operations.check_working_environment: Run the author's check that the working environment offers what the scripts need.
operations.materialize_workspace: Assemble the workspace afresh from the source and the REE's scripts, undoing whatever changed it.
operations.build_experiment_environment: Build the experiment environment with the build experiment environment script.
operations.generate_sbom: List the software in the built experiment environment.
operations.cross_check_sbom: Compare the dependencies the source declares with the SBOM.
operations.activate_experiment_environment: Run the activate experiment environment script alone: it enters the experiment environment and hands over.
operations.run_experiment: Run one declared experiment and verify its outputs.
operations.seal_ree: Freeze the REE and its evidence under one digest: nothing the seal covers changes after this.
operations.sign_ree: Add one signed claim about a sealed REE: a Sigstore bundle over its digest, beside what the seal covers.
operations.sign_review: Sign a review of a sealed REE: a Sigstore bundle naming the seal, with the review's record as its predicate; the review changes no more.

review_operations.review_acquire_source: Open a review: acquire the source the author pinned, from its origin or from the REE's own snapshot.
review_operations.review_build_experiment_environment: Rebuild the experiment environment from the review's source, or certify the one the REE ships.
review_operations.review_activate_experiment_environment: Run the author's activate experiment environment script alone, in the review's workspace.
review_operations.review_run_experiment: Reproduce one experiment in the review, and compare its outputs with the author's.

undeclared.description: A subject the vocabulary does not declare: the owner's own, never judged.

Attempt.description: One command execution inside an REE, from its pending record to its published capture. Evidence: git.

AuthorApiAction.description: One thing an author asked of an REE, from the request to the answer they were given. Evidence: journal.

Drift.description: One file of an REE changed, added or removed outside ree. Evidence: journal.

Execution.description: One executor process a workbench started for a command, from its start to its end, across workbench restarts. Evidence: journal.

Receipt.description: One step's receipt, and whether it still speaks for the REE as it now stands. Evidence: git.

Ree.description: The author REE's committed state: authored while draft, frozen once sealed. Evidence: git.

Review.description: One review of an REE: open while its steps run again, final once signed. Evidence: git.

WorkbenchSession.description: One workbench's connection serving one store, from its hello to the end of its socket. Evidence: journal.

cancel_run.description: One request to stop the executor of a started command, and the single outcome the sender observed.

follow_run.description: One watch over a started command, until it ends or the session it was sent on does.

run_command.description: One ree command the environment ran, and the exit status it saw.

start_run.description: One typed command sent to a workbench to start, and the single answer the sender observed.
